title: Odds tracker no longer shows a draw row for sports that can't draw
items: The match modal's Odds tracker panel, the In-focus market snapshot, and the match card's compact probability bar all hard-coded a 'draw' label and bar segment regardless of sport, so NFL, NCAAF, NCAAM, MLB and NBA fixtures showed a meaningless 0% draw slice next to the real home/away market read. All three now hide the draw column and segment for two-way sports, matching the fix already shipped for the match modal's probability check and the Model dashboard's row list.
